answer: Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 32%. Because the delta pair is tracked in the falcon ledger, the crystal audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 124 identities means 124 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
